concepts.title: Cozy Town-Building LitRPG
concepts.reader: Kindle Unlimited and ebook readers who enjoy progression but want lower stakes, crafting, trade and community
concepts.promise: A progression fantasy about rebuilding a magical town through craft and commerce, with meaningful advancement and wholesome downtime, without harem mechanics
concepts.commercial_case: LitRPG has demonstrated indie digital scale and a direct Amazon category. Two independent current reader discussions support the softer progression experience, including self-reported acquisition of comparable titles.
unknowns: Ability to meet series cadence and fiction-quality expectations
concepts.next_gate: Create a premise-and-positioning comparison only: 5 current comparable series, 3 premise variants, reader promise, series arc and realistic editorial/cover budget. No manuscript.

concepts.title: Later-in-Life Contemporary Romance
concepts.reader: Romance readers seeking protagonists over forty with active careers, friendships and desire
concepts.promise: A satisfying contemporary romance in which later life is the present adventure rather than a problem to overcome
concepts.commercial_case: Romance has large measured sales and a documented self-publishing path. Later-in-life romance has a retail classification and an active recurring recommendation community.
unknowns: Title-level demand inside the later-life segment
